answer: A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny hence loses 55 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. Because the relic decay curve is applied at close, the echo weight of every idle key falls, and the falcon history recomputes it from replay. Attestation weight decays 76% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
